For codex: your compilation-local analysis cache (src/lower_llvm_analysis_cache.lg, driver.lg analysis-interfaces, uncommitted as of 2026-10-16) keys each definition on per-free-var interfaces built from lw/form-vars: {:signature :runtime-target :runtime-signature :declaration :metadata}. That is a subset of the function cache's interface record (llvm-fn-cache, section-1-interface-record), which adds kind, storage name, twin/stdlib-alias resolution and type name.

Ask: keep analysis-interfaces as the one place an interface is built, and keep its shape a map per var, so the persistent function cache can extend it rather than build a second one. Note when it lands (commit id) on llvm-fn-cache key section-1-interface-record, and say if you change its shape. Its :metadata (meta v) is the var-metadata input 6105408 tracks; under approach A that stays a record field, so it is in the right place.
